routes.name: Deeplands
routes.action: Break an ore-tagged block at Y ≤ 5 while carrying a Blank Realmstone.
checks: Survival player; Creative is explicitly excluded.
The block must belong to Forge’s ore block tag.
One Blank Realmstone is consumed when the condition succeeds.
routes.warning: The code checks the ore tag and height, not a special ore species or a guaranteed mining location.

routes.name: Precasia
routes.action: Craft a Blank Realmstone with one each of the six vanilla 1.16.5 saplings: oak, birch, spruce, jungle, acacia and dark oak.
checks: Seven ingredients in a crafting table.
Shapeless: their arrangement does not matter.
Six copies of one sapling do not substitute for the six named species.
routes.warning: This is the 3.6.11 recipe. Do not replace it with the modern archaeology route.

routes.name: Barathos
routes.action: Deliver the killing melee blow to a Husk with the Blank Realmstone in your main hand.
checks: The target must be a Husk, not an ordinary Zombie.
The stone’s hurtEnemy callback checks that the target’s health has reached zero.
The main-hand stack becomes the Barathos Realmstone.
routes.warning: Weaken the Husk with another weapon, then switch for the finishing hit. Carrying the stone while killing with a sword is not the same trigger.

routes.name: Lelyetia
routes.action: Complete a fall whose event distance is greater than 25 blocks, carrying a Blank Realmstone.
checks: The fall event must retain a positive damage multiplier.
One Blank Realmstone is consumed.
The code tests fall distance, not the height of a tower.
routes.warning: Prepare protection and recovery. An effect that sets the event’s damage multiplier to zero can prevent this trigger; the condition does not guarantee survival.

routes.name: Creeponia
routes.action: Take a Creeper explosion hit with primed TNT nearby and a Blank Realmstone in inventory.
checks: Player health must be positive at the inspected hurt callback.
A TNT entity must intersect the Creeper’s or player’s bounding box expanded by 3 blocks.
The damage source must be an explosion directly from a Creeper.
routes.warning: Placed TNT blocks are not TNT entities. The inspected code does not check the TNT fuse value. Treat this as a dangerous in-game challenge, not a guarantee that the hit will be survivable.

routes.name: Nether
routes.action: Toss the Blank Realmstone while your player is in lava.
checks: The toss event checks the player’s isInLava state.
The tossed blank item entity is removed and the Nether Realmstone is given to the player.
routes.warning: Throwing the stone into lava while standing safely on land does not satisfy this code. Arrange fire protection and an exit before attempting it.

routes.name: Abyss
routes.action: Summon a Wither in the Nether while carrying a Blank Realmstone.
checks: The world-join check identifies a Wither with 220 invulnerable spawn ticks.
Eligible players are sought in the Wither’s bounding box expanded by 50 blocks.
Each qualifying player’s blank stone is consumed.
routes.warning: This is a summon trigger, not a requirement to defeat the Wither. The Wither still creates a real encounter and terrain risk in your game.

routes.name: Crystevia
routes.action: Interact with a living Case Construct while holding the Deep Crystal block item.
checks: Carry a Blank Realmstone as well.
The blank is consumed and the reward is given.
Outside Creative, one held Deep Crystal is also consumed.
routes.warning: Do not kill the Case Construct first. A similarly named crystal ingredient is not necessarily the required block item.

routes.name: Iromine
routes.where: Mineralization Station; GUI suggests Barathos route
routes.action: Use a Blank Realmstone on a Mineralization Station.
checks: The interaction replaces the held blank with the Iromine Realmstone.
The inspected station branch itself has no dimension check.
routes.warning: The GUI parent indicates a progression route, not a hard-coded requirement that this particular interaction happen in Barathos.

routes.name: Candyland
routes.action: Finish eating a Heart Fruit in Precasia while carrying a Blank Realmstone.
checks: The source applies 7 points of self-harm first.
You must still have positive health afterward.
One blank stone is consumed for the reward.
routes.warning: Heal before eating. The exact resulting damage can depend on the game’s damage handling; the source’s 7-point request is not a live measurement.

routes.name: Gardencia
routes.action: Drop a Blank Realmstone into a fully grown carrot crop in Precasia, then defeat the Primitive Carrotop it creates.
checks: The dropped item’s block position must contain a max-age vanilla carrot crop.
The blank item entity and carrot block are removed when the creature is created.
The creature’s server-side death in Precasia drops the Gardencia Realmstone.
routes.warning: An immature crop does not qualify. This is a spawned encounter and a ground drop, not an instant inventory exchange.

routes.name: Haven
routes.action: Kill a Flye with melee in Lelyetia while your player is at Y ≥ 120.
checks: The killer must be a player.
The height test uses the player’s Y, not the Flye’s Y.
Carry a Blank Realmstone; one is consumed.
routes.warning: Ranged kills do not satisfy the inspected melee condition. Prepare a safe fighting platform and fall recovery.

routes.name: Celeve
routes.action: Kill a Lelyetian Warrior using player-attributed firework damage while carrying a Blank Realmstone.
checks: The damage-source message ID must be fireworks.
The source entity must resolve directly to a PlayerEntity in this callback.
One blank is consumed.
routes.warning: A firework visual effect or a separate finishing blow is not sufficient. This guide has not live-tested every launcher or modded damage source.

routes.name: Mysterium
routes.action: Kill a Creepird while your player has Poison and carries a Blank Realmstone.
checks: The death callback runs server-side.
The player is resolved from the killer or applicable owner.
Poison must be active when the death condition is checked.
routes.warning: Bring a recovery plan for Poison. The kill alone, followed by poisoning yourself later, does not meet the condition.

routes.name: Vox Ponds
routes.action: Interact with an AoA trader or banker in Creeponia using the Blank Realmstone while environmentally protected.
checks: The held item must still be the blank stone.
The protection helper checks an AdventArmour helmet’s airtight contract.
A complete Hazmat set satisfies Hazmat’s contract; the source also defines other airtight helmets.
routes.warning: Do not assume a Hazmat helmet alone counts as the full Hazmat set. The GUI names Hazmat, while the actual helper is broader.

routes.name: Lborean
routes.action: Expose an eligible Gardencian creature to Candied Water, then kill it as a player while carrying a Blank Realmstone.
checks: Broccohead and nine other inspected plant-creature classes store a candiedWater flag on contact.
The flag persists in entity save data.
The death callback requires a player killer and consumes one blank stone.
routes.warning: Ordinary water is not Candied Water. In the inspected Broccohead path, contact also adds 50 maximum health and multiplies current health by 1.5, making this a stronger target.

routes.name: Dustopia
routes.action: Activate the Shadow Altar with its Book of Shadows while Night Vision is active and you carry a Blank Realmstone.
checks: The altar’s activation condition requires the Abyss.
The reward is issued during successful activation, alongside scheduling Shadowlord’s spawn.
One blank is consumed.
routes.warning: Do not wait until after activation to apply Night Vision. Prepare for Shadowlord even though the realmstone reward does not require defeating the boss.

routes.name: Greckon
routes.action: Interact with Elusive while holding Nightmare Flakes and carrying a Blank Realmstone.
checks: The interaction is server-side.
One blank and one held Nightmare Flakes item are consumed.
The reward is given directly rather than requiring an Elusive kill.
routes.warning: Approach with the correct held item. A loot drop after defeating Elusive is a different mechanism.

routes.name: Lunalus
routes.action: Select a Gravitator and move airborne over the void in Haven while carrying a Blank Realmstone in the main inventory.
checks: The item’s selected inventory tick must run; Creative is excluded.
The check runs every five game ticks while airborne.
The source checks for empty blocks below before consuming a blank.
routes.warning: The inspected loop cumulatively subtracts its index from a mutable Y position, so it is not a straightforward every-block column scan. Use a genuine open-void location and a reliable return plan; exact trigger geometry still needs live testing.

routes.name: Runandor
routes.action: Place a Vox Light in Mysterium, drop a Blank Realmstone and one Runic Energy above it, then use an Active Rune Stone on the light.
checks: The two dropped item entities must intersect the one-block cube immediately above the light.
The blank entity is converted to the Runandor Realmstone.
The Active Rune Stone is consumed and the Runic Energy item entity is removed.
routes.warning: Drop one Runic Energy, not a valuable stack: the source removes its entire item entity. Keep unrelated dropped items away; the loop can revisit a successful match because it does not break immediately afterward.

routes.name: Shyrelands
routes.action: Craft Darkly Powder, Bloodstone, Glowstone, Haunted Flower, Magic Mending Solution and a Blank Realmstone together.
checks: Six exact ingredients, shapeless.
Use the complete recipe from AoA 3.6.11.
GUI parents point toward Greckon and Dustopia as progression hints.
routes.warning: The ingredient’s item ID matters. The recipe explorer shows the exact versioned resources and images.

routes.name: Nowhere
routes.where: Construct of Strength encounter, associated with Crystevia
routes.action: Carry a Blank Realmstone and survive an attack from a Construct of Strength that has Strength active.
checks: The inspected onAttack callback requires a player target with positive health.
The construct itself must have the Strength effect.
One blank is consumed and the Nowhere Realmstone is given.
routes.warning: The released GUI still describes a crafting recipe involving a Shulker Box, Golden Apple, End Crystal and Beacon. No such bundled 3.6.11 recipe was found. The released Construct of Strength class contains the blank-to-Nowhere reward path; do not spend those crafting ingredients based on the stale hint.
